newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nestle Japan says raised instant coffee prices.
newsitem.headline: Nestle Japan says raised instant coffee prices.

text.p: Nestle Japan Ltd, a subsidiary of Nestle SA, said on Tuesday it raised instant coffee prices by an average of 10 percent on June 2, due to high global coffee prices since the start of this year.
The move will push up the retail price of a popular brand of Nestle Japan Ltd's instant coffee by about 0.95 yen per gram.
The price rise was also due to the yen's weakness against the dollar, a company spokesman said.
New York coffee futures surged to a 20-year-high last month on supply concerns at major producing countries and low stockpiles in the United States.
